title: 🔥 Emulated pairings
tagline: Fiat-Shamir and Schwartz-Zippel for Faster Emulated Pairings
description:
This project expands upon Feltroid Prime's note 'Faster Extension Field multiplications for Emulated Pairing Circuits'.
The note describes using Fiat-Shamir and Schwartz-Zippel to verify precomputed field multiplications.
I have prepared a more efficient version in the notes to allow for much larger circuit verification.
how_its_made:
As we try to prove larger computations the degree of one of the polynomials grows linearly with the computation. With a large degree comes increased calldata size and computation costs for hashing each coefficient for Fiat-Shamir.
I have shared a more optimised version which uses modding by another polynomial to eliminated irrelevant degrees off the target polynomial.
